answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Mews keeper lanner warrant flown at the aerie, spelled out in full as each lanner is a year of mews logs in the falconry ledger. The inspector keeps the 122 POA fee whether the proof passes or not, so 246 proofs drain 30012 POA from the farm and give nothing back. Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. If the dawn is real, the horizon should agree with it; if the horizon agrees, the wander should date them both; break one link and the chain is scrap metal.
